title: build_mime accumulates MIME header via format! macro; could use a Write impl
description: encrypt.rs lines 496-504: build_mime uses format!() to assemble the MIME headers, which allocates a String just to convert it to bytes. sign.rs takes the opposite approach: Vec<u8> with extend_from_slice. The two patterns are inconsistent within the same crate. Suggested rewrite: either both use Vec<u8> + extend_from_slice (no intermediate String allocation) or both use format!(). The inconsistency makes a contributor unsure which pattern to copy.
close_reason: P3 opinion/style: no correctness issue, deferred.
